macros.name: BreakPageOnVersion
macros.doc: If you want to insert pagebreaks before questions or sections conditionally on the exam, you will need to use the \BreakPageOnVersion{} macro.

macros.name: class
macros.doc: The \class macro takes one argument: the name of the class to appear on the exam.

macros.name: ConstantBlanks
macros.doc: \ConstantBlanks has one mandatory argument (a length). It tells TeX to typeset the underline in fill-in-the-blank environments using lines of a constant length, regardless of the length of the correct word.

macros.name: examname
macros.doc: \examname takes one argument, just like \class. The argument is used to identify the type of test.

macros.name: InsertChunk
macros.doc: At the appropriate place in your exam, place \InsertChunk{chunk name}. This macro inserts the named chunk into the exam (or key) at that place.

macros.name: key
macros.doc: The \key macro takes one argument, which can be any command or sequence of commands subject to the constraints described in the technical notes. The argument will be included wherever it is if and only if a key is being made, otherwise the argument will be ignored.

macros.name: NoKey
macros.doc: The switch \NoKey suppresses the generation of all answer keys, whereas \OneKey generates an answer key for the first exam only.

macros.name: NoRearrange
macros.doc: The \NoRearrange switch suppresses the rearrangement of questions.

macros.name: NumberOfVersions
macros.doc: The \NumberOfVersions macro takes a single numerical argument—the number of different versions of the test to generate.

macros.name: OneKey
macros.doc: The switch \NoKey suppresses the generation of all answer keys, whereas \OneKey generates an answer key for the first exam only.

macros.name: ProportionalBlanks
macros.doc: \ProportionalBlanks has one mandatory argument (a real number r). It tells TeX to typeset the underline in fill-in-the-blank environments using lines that are exactly r times the length of the correct answer when the correct answer is typeset by TeX.

macros.name: setrandomseed
macros.doc: The \setrandomseed macro allows you to specify a random seed at the start of an exam.

macros.name: StudentInfoLineSpacing
macros.doc: \StudentInfoLineSpacing requires a length as its argument. This value is used to determine the amount of additional spacing between lines in the student data box appearing in the upper right-hand corner of the exam.

macros.name: UnderlineCorrectMultipleChoiceAnswer
macros.doc: The switch \UnderlineCorrectMultipleChoiceAnswer identifies the correct answer in multiple choice questions by underlining.

macros.name: word
macros.doc: This command allows the user to insert inessential changes in the wording of a question between various versions of the exam.

envs.name: block
envs.doc: The block environment lets you identify a group of questions, as well as some preceeding text, as a “block” that should be kept together even though the rest of the section gets rearranged.

envs.name: endmatter
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the endmatter environment will be typeset on a page (or pages) by itself after the exam (and the key, too).

envs.name: exampreface
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the exampreface environment will be typeset on the same page as the examtop text, right beneath it but before any sections of the exam are included.

envs.name: examtop
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the examtop environment will be typeset on the next page following the frontmatter text, if an exam is being created, and will be omitted if an answer key is being created.

envs.name: frontmatter
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the frontmatter environment will be typeset on a page (or pages) by itself before the exam (and the key, too).

envs.name: keypreface
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the keypreface environment will be typeset on the same page as the keytop text, right beneath it but before any sections are included.

envs.name: keytop
envs.doc: Any material enclosed in the keytop environment will be typeset on the next page following the frontmatter text, if a key is being created, and will be omitted if an exam is being created.

envs.name: shortanswer
envs.doc: The shortanswer environment does not format its questions in any way other than enumerating them.
